title: The states of an instance
claim: A stopped instance can start again, but a terminated instance is gone for good.
alt: A state diagram with six states: pending, running, stopping, stopped, shutting-down and terminated. Launch leads to pending and running; stop leads through stopping to stopped; start leads back to pending; terminate leads through shutting-down to terminated, which is final.
notes: Brief 16; 2-deep.md stop-reboot-terminate subsection, after the table; caption, no steps. Title, claim, alt, states, transitions from brief.json. Main path runs down column A; the stop path uses column B, and start returns on the right. Hibernation passes through stopping to stopped (ec2-faq-hibernated-state-is-stopped). Caption facts: ec2-state-running-billed, ec2-state-stopped-not-billed, ec2-terminated-instance-cannot-recover. No AWS number in the drawing.
